answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in ridge, expire in crystal, and onyx lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 172 aliases therefore needs 75 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 175 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
